ll applicants and their parents must not hold Korean citizenship, OR must have completed the entire curriculum of 16 years or more

Educational
Background
• Master's Degree Applicants: Must have (or expect to obtain by February 28, 2027) a bachelor’s degree.
• Doctoral Degree Applicants: Must have (or expect to obtain by February 28, 2027)  a master’s degree.

Proﬁciency 
Requirements

roﬁciency: TOPIK level 4 or higher OR
② English Proﬁciency: TOEFL iBT 71 or higher, IEL TS 5.5 or higher ,TEPS 600 or higher (New TEPS 234 or higher)
※  A
pplicants from countries where English is a mother tongue or an oﬃcial language may submit a certiﬁcate of higher education with English as the
Medium of Instruction (MOI) instead of an oﬃcial English proﬁciency test score.
B Korean P
roﬁciency: TOPIK level 4 or above only.
※ Please not
e that some departments and majors may require a higher TOPIK level.
